questionText:
Processes $P1, P2, P3, P4$ arrive in that order at times 0, 1, 2, and 8 milliseconds respectively, and have execution times of 10, 13, 6, and 9 milliseconds respectively. Shortest Remaining Time First (SRTF) algorithm is used as the CPU scheduling policy. Ignore context switching times.

Which ONE of the following correctly gives the average turnaround time of the four processes in milliseconds?
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

1. Given Process Details:
• $P1$: Arrival Time ($AT$) = 0 ms, Burst Time ($BT$) = 10 ms
• $P2$: Arrival Time ($AT$) = 1 ms, Burst Time ($BT$) = 13 ms
• $P3$: Arrival Time ($AT$) = 2 ms, Burst Time ($BT$) = 6 ms
• $P4$: Arrival Time ($AT$) = 8 ms, Burst Time ($BT$) = 9 ms

2. CPU Execution Trace (Gantt Chart):
• $t = 0 \text{ to } 2$: $P1$ runs for 2 ms. Remaining time of $P1$ becomes 8 ms. At $t = 2$, $P3$ arrives with $BT = 6\text{ ms}$. Since $6 < 8$, $P1$ is preempted and $P3$ takes the CPU.
• $t = 2 \text{ to } 8$: $P3$ runs to completion (6 ms). Completion Time ($CT$) of $P3 = 8\text{ ms}$.
• $t = 8$: $P4$ arrives with $BT = 9\text{ ms}$. Ready queue remaining times: $P1$ (8 ms), $P4$ (9 ms), $P2$ (13 ms). $P1$ has the shortest remaining time.
• $t = 8 \text{ to } 16$: $P1$ runs its remaining 8 ms to completion. Completion Time ($CT$) of $P1 = 16\text{ ms}$.
• $t = 16 \text{ to } 25$: $P4$ runs for 9 ms to completion. Completion Time ($CT$) of $P4 = 25\text{ ms}$.
• $t = 25 \text{ to } 38$: $P2$ runs for 13 ms to completion. Completion Time ($CT$) of $P2 = 38\text{ ms}$.

3. Calculate Turnaround Time ($TAT = CT - AT$):
• $TAT(P1) = 16 - 0 = 16\text{ ms}$
• $TAT(P2) = 38 - 1 = 37\text{ ms}$
• $TAT(P3) = 8 - 2 = 6\text{ ms}$
• $TAT(P4) = 25 - 8 = 17\text{ ms}$

4. Calculate Average Turnaround Time:
$$\text{Average } TAT = \frac{16 + 37 + 6 + 17}{4} = \frac{76}{4} = 19\text{ ms}$$

Hence, the correct answer is 19, corresponding to Option (D).
